text:
Yeah, that all sounds good. I want to return the skateboards and the smart watch, and get the $728.04 refund to my credit card ending in 9375. Yeah, no problem with the wait time for the refund too.

So, just to confirm, if I say "yes," my order will go into "return requested" status, and I'll get an email with the next steps? Yeah, that sounds fine. Okay, so I confirm. Yes.
zh:
是的，听起来都很好。我想退货滑板和智能手表，并将$728.04退款到我的信用卡尾号为9375的账户。是的，退款等待时间也没问题。

所以，为了确认，如果我说“yes”，我的订单将变为“退货申请”状态，我会收到一封包含下一步操作的邮件？是的，听起来不错。好的，所以我确认。是的。
